capability.summary: Hosted vision-language model for coding and document analysis.
capability.problem_space: Hosted vision-language model for coding and document analysis. Applicable tasks include code revision, document interpretation, visual reasoning, tool-assisted analysis. Accepts text, image input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions.

env_requirements: Endpoint exposing the documented model through Chat Completions; gateway mapping unverified
Valid API key for the selected service or an explicitly configured self-hosted endpoint
Endpoint and transport support for every requested input and output modality
Provider-hosted integrations are not automatically available through the configured gateway.
constraint.io_signature: Input modalities: text, image | Output modalities: text. Gateway transport support requires verification.
